evasion_asymmetry.interpretation: EMBER is evaded by a cosmetic lossless re-save that leaves the payload fully functional (see semantic_stability: 78.4%% verdict flips). Reachability can be evaded ONLY by severing the trigger->action path, which removes the dangerous capability itself (ACTIVE->ABSENT in 87.5%% of cases). The asymmetry: evading the byte detector costs nothing; evading reachability costs the attack.
